headline: Relive the Scorchers incredible run to the WAFCON Final
body: In their first ever WAFCON, the Scorchers beat 10x-champions Nigeria and qualified for the 2027 World Cup in Brazil on the way to the Final.

headline: Week 14 of the FDH Bank Premiership
body: Big matches: Can Blue Eagles rebound from last week's disappointing loss in a Lilongwe Derby against Masters FC at Civo Stadium on Saturday? On Sunday, Karonga United look to escape the relegation zone against northern rivals Chitipa United on Sunday. Every match covered on Everyleague.
